quests.instruction: A plain baked potato and white bread have a soft, gentle taste. Which word describes it?
quests.hint: This taste is the calm opposite of a fiery hot pepper.
quests.explanation: Nice work! A plain baked potato and white bread both share this soft, gentle taste!
quests.funFact: Mild flavors are very gentle and don't overpower your taste buds.

quests.instruction: Coffee and grapefruit share a taste that isn't sweet or sour, just sharp. What's it called?
quests.hint: This taste is why some drinks need a splash of milk.
quests.explanation: You found it! Coffee and grapefruit both share this sharp taste that isn't sweet or sour!
quests.funFact: Bitter is one of the five basic tastes, along with sweet, sour, salty, and umami.

quests.instruction: Ripe watermelon and honey share the same yummy taste. What is that taste called?
quests.hint: It's the taste that makes you want dessert after dinner.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Watermelon and honey are both full of natural sugar, which tastes sweet!
quests.funFact: Sweetness is the taste of natural sugars found in fruits and honey.

quests.instruction: A plain cracker with nothing on it has barely any strong taste. What word fits?
quests.hint: It's the taste that leaves lots of room for toppings to shine.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! A plain cracker has barely any strong taste, matching this gentle word!
quests.funFact: Mild foods are perfect for people who don't like spicy or sour things.

quests.instruction: Movie popcorn and pretzel sticks share this snack-time taste. What's the word?
quests.hint: This taste usually comes from a small shaker with tiny holes on top.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Movie popcorn and pretzel sticks both share this classic snack-time taste!
quests.funFact: Salt is an essential mineral that our bodies need to survive.

quests.instruction: Milk with nothing flavored mixed in and a rice cake with no topping share this taste. What's the word?
quests.hint: This word describes the taste of a food exactly as it naturally is.
quests.explanation: Yes! Plain milk and a plain rice cake both share this natural, nothing-added taste!
quests.funFact: Plain foods have no extra spices or flavors added to them.

quests.instruction: A green apple and a pickle share a tangy, sharp taste. What's it called?
quests.hint: It's the opposite of the taste in birthday cake.
quests.explanation: That's right! Green apples and pickles both have that sharp, tangy taste!
quests.funFact: Sourness is the taste of acidity, like the juice of a lemon.

quests.instruction: A bagel with nothing spread on it and pasta with no sauce share this basic taste. What word fits?
quests.hint: This taste has nothing sweet, salty, or spicy added to it.
quests.explanation: Great job! A bare bagel and sauceless pasta both share this same basic, nothing-added taste!
quests.funFact: A plain cracker is often eaten to help settle an upset stomach.

quests.instruction: Hot mustard and pepperoni with red pepper flakes share this bite. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This taste can wake up your whole mouth in a hurry.
quests.explanation: You got it! Hot mustard and pepperoni with red flakes both share this bold, fiery bite!
quests.funFact: Spicy foods create a burning sensation on your tongue.

quests.instruction: Coffee beans and dark leafy greens share a taste many kids don't love yet. What's the word?
quests.hint: This taste is often the reason people add sugar or cream to a drink.
quests.explanation: Well done! Coffee beans and dark leafy greens both carry this taste, often called bitter!
quests.funFact: Dark chocolate and black coffee are famously bitter foods.

quests.instruction: A donut and a lollipop both have this sugary taste. Can you name it?
quests.hint: It's the opposite of a taste that makes you scrunch up your face.
quests.explanation: Correct! Donuts and lollipops are both sugary treats, and that's what this taste word means!
quests.funFact: Our brains are hardwired to crave sweet foods because they provide quick energy.

quests.instruction: A kiwi fruit and cranberry juice share a tart, tangy taste. What word fits?
quests.hint: This taste makes some people scrunch up their nose.
quests.explanation: Super! Kiwi fruit and cranberry juice both share that same tart, tangy taste!
quests.funFact: Eating something very sour makes your mouth pucker and water.

quests.instruction: Ice cream and chocolate bars share a sugary, delicious taste. What word fits?
quests.hint: This is the taste most desserts are famous for.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Ice cream and chocolate are both sugary treats, which is what this word describes!
quests.funFact: Honey is a natural sweet syrup made by bees from flower nectar.

quests.instruction: Kimchi and hot chili oil both bring this bold, fiery taste. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This taste is often paired with a cool glass of milk to calm it down.
quests.explanation: You found it! Kimchi and hot chili oil both bring this bold, fiery taste!
quests.funFact: The heat in spicy peppers comes from a chemical called capsaicin.

quests.instruction: Plain oatmeal and a banana have a gentle, easy taste. What word fits best?
quests.hint: This taste won't surprise your tongue at all.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Plain oatmeal and a banana both share this gentle, easy taste!
quests.funFact: Many cheeses start off mild and get sharper as they age for months.

quests.instruction: A ghost pepper and spicy ramen noodles share this fiery taste. What's the word?
quests.hint: This taste can make some people's whole face turn a little red.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Ghost peppers and spicy ramen both bring this same fiery taste!
quests.funFact: Drinking milk is much better than water for cooling down a spicy mouth.

quests.instruction: Toast with no butter or jam and rice with nothing mixed in share this taste. What word fits?
quests.hint: This word describes a food with zero extra flavors added.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Plain toast and rice with nothing added share this same simple taste!
quests.funFact: Eating plain rice helps balance out very spicy side dishes.

quests.instruction: Lemons and limes make your mouth pucker up. What taste is that?
quests.hint: It's the taste that makes your eyes squint a little.
quests.explanation: Yes! Lemons and limes both have a sharp, mouth-puckering taste called sour!
quests.funFact: Sour candies are coated in a special edible acid to give them their kick.

quests.instruction: Cookies and maple syrup both have a sugary taste. Which word matches that taste?
quests.hint: Babies naturally love this taste more than any other.
quests.explanation: That's right! Cookies and maple syrup are both sugary, exactly what this taste word means!
quests.funFact: Too much sweet food can give you a stomach ache and cause cavities.

quests.instruction: Cooked noodles with no sauce and a cracker with no topping share this taste. What's the word?
quests.hint: This word describes a taste with absolutely nothing extra added.
quests.explanation: Great job! Noodles without sauce and a topping-free cracker both share this same taste!
quests.funFact: Plain yogurt is sour but extremely healthy for your digestion.

quests.instruction: Steamed white rice on its own has a soft, gentle taste. Which taste word fits?
quests.hint: This taste is calm, like the quiet opposite of a spicy dish.
quests.explanation: You got it! Plain steamed rice has this soft, gentle taste!
quests.funFact: A mild salsa has almost no spicy chili peppers in it.

quests.instruction: Rhubarb and sour candy share a sharp, tangy bite. Which taste word matches?
quests.hint: Some candies are even named after this exact taste.
quests.explanation: Well done! Rhubarb and sour candy both share that same sharp, tangy bite!
quests.funFact: Fermented foods like pickles and yogurt have a naturally sour taste.

quests.instruction: Dark chocolate and unsweetened cocoa share a taste that isn't sweet at all. What is it?
quests.hint: This taste is often balanced out with a little sugar.
quests.explanation: Correct! Dark chocolate and unsweetened cocoa both share this taste that isn't sweet at all!
quests.funFact: Humans evolved to detect bitter tastes to avoid eating poisonous plants.

quests.instruction: Bacon and roasted peanuts share a savory taste. Which taste word describes it?
quests.hint: It's the taste added to food using a small shaker.
quests.explanation: Super! Bacon and roasted peanuts both carry this savory taste from a shaker!
quests.funFact: Adding salt to food actually enhances the other flavors in the dish.

quests.instruction: A hot dog bun with nothing inside and popcorn with no seasoning share this taste. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This word means simple and totally basic, with nothing extra mixed in.
quests.explanation: Nice work! An empty bun and unseasoned popcorn both share this simple, basic taste!
quests.funFact: Did you know? plain foods have no extra spices or flavors added to them.

quests.instruction: Plain pasta with a little butter has a soft, gentle taste. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This taste is calm and easy, never surprising.
quests.explanation: You found it! Plain buttered pasta has this soft, gentle taste!
quests.funFact: Did you know? mild flavors are very gentle and don't overpower your taste buds.

quests.instruction: Vinegar and lemon juice share a sharp, tangy taste. What word describes it?
quests.hint: Cooks use a splash of this taste to wake up a recipe's flavor.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Vinegar and lemon juice both carry that same sharp, tangy taste!
quests.funFact: Did you know? sourness is the taste of acidity, like the juice of a lemon.

quests.instruction: Grapefruit peel and dark chocolate share a sharp, less-sweet taste. Which word fits?
quests.hint: This taste is the opposite of a super sugary dessert.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Grapefruit peel and dark chocolate both carry this sharp, less-sweet taste!
quests.funFact: Adding a tiny bit of salt can actually reduce the bitterness of food.

quests.instruction: Honey and caramel both taste rich and sugary. Which taste word describes them?
quests.hint: This taste often shows up in your favorite desserts.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Honey and caramel are both sugary and rich, which is what this taste word means!
quests.funFact: Did you know? sweetness is the taste of natural sugars found in fruits and honey.

quests.instruction: Plain crackers and boiled rice have a very gentle taste, not strong at all. What word fits?
quests.hint: This is the taste of food that hasn't been given big, bold flavors.
quests.explanation: Yes! Plain crackers and boiled rice both have a gentle taste, exactly what this word means!
quests.funFact: Did you know? mild foods are perfect for people who don't like spicy or sour things.
